name: Poltergeist
descr: A baleful, translucent spirit that possesses inanimate objects.

data.motivesAndTactics: Flicker candles, rattle chains, shake windows, throw people around the room

features.name: Specter
features.text: The Poltergeist has resistance to physical damage. **Mark a Stress** to move up to Close range through solid objects.

features.name: Possessor
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Poltergeist inhabit a nonmagical object that is entirely within Close range, infusing the object with a ghostly glow. The next time the Poltergeist would take damage, the object is destroyed instead, and the Poltergeist is expelled from it.

features.name: Ghost Storm
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Poltergeist pull all unequipped nonmagical objects within Very Close range into a violent vortex. Each target in that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **1d12+2** physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.
